dataset_name: ShelfLife AI Unified Cold Chain Telemetry

column_descriptions.container_id: Unique identifier for shipping container or reefer unit
column_descriptions.timestamp: ISO-8601 recording timestamp of sensor observation
column_descriptions.temperature: Cargo storage temperature in degrees Celsius (°C)
column_descriptions.door_events: Binary flag indicating door opening excursion (0=closed, 1=open)
column_descriptions.product_type: Perishable cargo classification (vaccines, pharma, seafood, mangoes, dairy, etc.)
